"""TradingAI Server Fix & Start - Does not kill itself."""
import base64
import os
import shutil
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time

PROJECT_DIR = r"C:\TradingAI\TradingAI\freqtrade"
API_DIR = os.path.join(PROJECT_DIR, "core", "api")
SERVER_FILE = os.path.join(API_DIR, "server.py")
BACKUP_FILE = os.path.join(API_DIR, "server.py.old")
AUTH_FILE = os.path.join(API_DIR, "auth.py")

AUTH_B64 = ""
SERVER_B64 = ""

def is_port_in_use(port: int) -> bool:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        return s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", port)) == 0

def write_file(path: str, b64_content: str):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(base64.b64decode(b64_content))
    print("  Written:", path)

def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("TradingAI Server Fix & Start")
    print("=" * 60)

    print("\n[1/6] Checking port 8000...")
    if is_port_in_use(8000):
        print("  WARNING: Port 8000 is already in use.")
        print("  Stop the old server first:")
        print("    Get-Process python | Stop-Process")
        print("  Or the new server may fail to start.")
    else:
        print("  Port 8000 is free.")

    print("\n[2/6] Ensuring directories...")
    os.makedirs(API_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    print(" ", API_DIR)

    print("\n[3/6] Backing up old server.py...")
    if os.path.exists(SERVER_FILE):
        shutil.copy2(SERVER_FILE, BACKUP_FILE)
        print("  Backed up to", BACKUP_FILE)

    print("\n[4/6] Writing auth.py...")
    write_file(AUTH_FILE, AUTH_B64)

    print("\n[5/6] Writing server.py...")
    write_file(SERVER_FILE, SERVER_B64)

    print("\n[6/6] Starting API server...")
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["JWT_SECRET_KEY"] = "tradingai-production-secret-change-this"
    env["PYTHONPATH"] = PROJECT_DIR

    proc = subprocess.Popen(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", "core.api.server:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"],
        cwd=PROJECT_DIR,
        env=env,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        text=True,
    )

    print("  Server starting... waiting 6 seconds")
    time.sleep(6)

    print("\n--- Verification ---")
    try:
        import urllib.request
        req = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8000/health")
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as resp:
            print("  GET /health:", resp.read().decode())
    except Exception as e:
        print("  GET /health FAILED:", e)

    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8000/token", data=b"", method="POST")
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as resp:
            import json
            token_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
            token = token_data["access_token"]
            print("  POST /token: OK (role:", token_data["role"], ")")
    except Exception as e:
        print("  POST /token FAILED:", e)
        token = None

    if token:
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8000/protected", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as resp:
                print("  GET /protected:", resp.read().decode())
        except Exception as e:
            print("  GET /protected FAILED:", e)

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("Server is running. Press Ctrl+C to stop.")
    print("=" * 60)

    try:
        for line in proc.stdout:
            print(line, end="")
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nStopping server...")
        proc.terminate()
        proc.wait()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
